settings.label: Description
settings.text: A fast-drying mist that lays down broad-spectrum protection and a veil of shimmer. It sprays in any direction, so shoulders, backs and legs are covered in seconds. Net weight 4 fl oz.

settings.label: How to use
settings.text: Shake well and hold the bottle about six inches from skin. Spray until the area glistens, then smooth it over if it is windy. Reapply at least every two hours and after swimming or sweating.

settings.label: Ingredients
settings.text: Built on modern sun filters with vitamin E for antioxidant support, hyaluronic acid for a hydrated feel and coconut-derived emollients for slip. Gold glow adds soft mica shimmer. The full list is printed on the bottle and in our standard.

settings.label: Benefits
settings.text: Broad spectrum against UVA and UVB. No white cast on any skin tone. Water resistant for 80 minutes. Compliant with reef-protection laws in Hawaii and Key West.

settings.text: A few firm shakes mix the shimmer into the formula.

settings.image_alt: Spraying the mist onto an arm
settings.label: Step two
settings.title: Spray until it glistens
settings.text: Hold six inches away and coat each area evenly; a sheen means enough product.

settings.label: Step three
settings.title: Smooth and set a timer
settings.text: Spread it with your palm, avoid the face, and reapply when two hours pass.

settings.label: Can I spray it on my face?
settings.text: Spray it into your hands first, then pat it onto your face and keep it away from eyes. Our face-friendly fluid is built for daily facial wear.

settings.label: How is the Gold glow different from Rose glow?
settings.text: Gold glow carries SPF 50 with a warmer shimmer, while Rose glow is SPF 42 with a cool pink-champagne tint.

settings.label: How long does a bottle last?
settings.text: Unopened it keeps for about two years, and for twelve months once opened. Store it out of a hot car.

settings.label: Is it safe while pregnant or on acne-prone skin?
settings.text: It is made without common irritants, but anyone pregnant or with a skin condition should check the label with their doctor first.

settings.heading: Protect, top up, recover
settings.text: Add a setting mist for touch-ups and a rich butter for the evening.
